thread:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: travel/offsite logistics  small thread for edge Qs (accommodations, insurance, booking windows). Keep it short and we'll update the handbook.

Diego (Eng): Does Redwood buy travel insurance for international offsites?

Aisha (People Ops): Not routinely. For high-risk trips or medical/evacuation needs, People Ops will approve insurance case-by-case. Put request in Offsite Request and mark "insurance needed".

Hannah (Design): Accessibility needs at hotels  can People Ops book accessible rooms on behalf of attendees?

Aisha (People Ops): Yes, flag accessibility requirements in the Offsite Request (mobility, dietary, sensory). We'll coordinate with Hotels and confirm before booking.

Liam (Sales): Deadline: when do attendee lists need to be final to lock rooms/transport?

Aisha (People Ops): Final attendee list 14 days before event to avoid penalties. For last-minute additions, expect additional costs.

Devon (Finance): Travel advances? Team leads can request up to 50% advance for confirmed travel; request via Finance Portal at least 10 business days before departure.

Diego (Eng): Can we book adjacent hotel rooms for family + employee if team wants to travel with partner? Policy?

Aisha (People Ops): Company covers employee room only. If partners share a room, teams should bill only the employee portion and document personal split on the expense report.

Facilities-Bot: Desk booking reminder: "Reserve desks up to 60 days ahead. Cancel >=24h to free space."

HR-Bot: Handbook note: "Offsite Accommodations & Special Needs" updated at 1823456700.

Liam (Sales): If an attendee cancels within 7 days, refund/charge handling?

Devon (Finance): Cancellation fees charged to the event budget; we recommend holds with lower cancellation penalties. Add a cancellation contingency line in the Offsite Request.

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks all  I'll fold this into the Workstyle/Offsite section and pin templates in #people-ops. DM me for urgent visa/insurance cases and I'll schedule a quick call.
